title: palicourea jauaensis

The therapeutic actions of Palicourea jauaensis include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its medicinal uses. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions are alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, such as jauaensine and 3,4-dihydroxybenzoic acid, which have been isolated from the plant.
